content:
# Testament of Simeon — 2
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1:1** A copy-of-the-words of-Simeon, the-things-which he-spoke to-his-sons before he-died, in-the hundred-and-twentieth year of-his-life, in-the year when Joseph died.
**1:2** For-Simeon fell-sick, and-his-sons came to-visit him; and-he-strengthened-himself-and-sat-up, and-kissed-them, and-said:
**1:3** Listen, my-children, to-Simeon your-father, and-I-will-tell you the-things which I have-in-my-heart.
**1:4** I-was-born of-Jacob my-father, his-second son; and-my-mother Leah named-me Simeon, because the-LORD heard her-voice.
**1:5** And I-became-strong exceedingly; I-did-not-draw-back from-any-deed, nor-was I-afraid-of-anything; for-my-heart was-hard and-my-liver-immovable, and-my-bowels had-no-compassion.
**1:6** Because-valour also had-been-given-to-me from-the-Most-High, through-works-of-might and-through-fortitude-of-heart.

**2:1** And-I-was-jealous-of-Joseph, because our-father loved-him above-all.
**2:2** And-I-set-my-mind to-kill-him, because the-prince-of-deceit sent-forth the-spirit of-jealousy and-blinded-my-mind, so-that-I-regarded-him-not as-a-brother, and-spared-not-Jacob my-father.
**2:3** But-his-God and-the-God-of-our-fathers sent-forth his-angel and-delivered-him from-my-hands.
**2:4** For-when I-went-to-Shechem to-fetch-ointment for-the-flocks, and-Reuben went-to-Dothan, where-were-our-provisions-and-all-our-stores, Judah our-brother sold-him to-the-Ishmaelites.
**2:5** And-when Reuben heard-[it] he-was-grieved; for-he-had-wished to-restore-him to-his-father.
**2:6** But-I had-been-jealous and-had-not-consented to-sell-him, but-I-kept-him-guarded seven-days; for-Judah had-sold-him in-my-absence.
**2:7** And-I-grieved-at-heart over-him for-a-long-time, for-I-had-sinned a-great-sin.
**2:8** And-Jacob our-father sought-for-him continually; so-also-did Leah my-mother weep, and-all-were-distressed and-moved.
**2:9** But-I-was-not-distressed, for-the-spirit of-jealousy had-hardened-my-heart.
**2:10** Then after-two-years I-heard-say that-Joseph had-been-sold to-Egypt; and-I-wept-bitterly, and-I-mourned-before-the-LORD, being-ashamed that-I-had-consented to-sell-him.

**3:1** And-now, my-children, take-heed to-yourselves-concerning-all-the-works-of-jealousy, for-jealousy rules over-the-whole-mind-of-a-man and-suffers-him-not to-eat, or-to-drink, or-to-do-any-good-thing.
**3:2** It-ever-forces-him to-destroy him-who-he-is-jealous-of; and-so-long-as he-who-is-envied-flourishes, he-who-is-jealous-fades-away.
**3:3** For-two-years I-was-vexed-in-soul concerning-Joseph, because the-LORD of-spirits saw-that-I-was-plotting-evil against-Joseph, and-he-weakened-my-hands-and-feet, and-I-was-unable-to-move-them.
**3:4** And-I-knew-that-what-had-befallen-me was-from-the-LORD; and-I-repented and-wept; and-I-sought-for-the-face-of-God with-all-my-heart that-he-might-deliver-my-hands-from-my-affliction.
**3:5** And-he-showed-me that-because-of-Joseph I-had-done-this, that-I-had-plotted-against-him; and-he-healed-me.

**4:1** And-now, my-children, love-ye-each-one-his-brother with-a-good-heart, and-the-spirit of-jealousy depart-from-you; for-this-makes-savage-the-soul and-destroys-the-body, it-causes-rage-and-war-in-the-mind, and-stirs-up-unto-blood, and-leads-the-mind-astray and-allows-it-not-to-work-with-understanding-and-equity.
**4:2** For-even to-Judah our-father the-LORD gave-a-spirit of-understanding and-long-suffering; for-he-was-among-the-most-merciful, and-he-would-have-done-away-with-the-jealousy against-Joseph had-it-not-been-for-Simeon his-brother.
**4:3** Beware therefore of-jealousy, my-children, and-love-ye-each-one-his-brother, and-take-away-the-hatred-of-your-hearts, loving-one-another in-deed and-in-word and-in-the-inclination-of-the-soul.
**4:4** For I-spoke-peaceably to-Joseph, and-when he-was-sold I-wept-inwardly; for-I-had-repented that-I-had-delivered-him-up-to-death in-mine-envy.

**5:1** And-now, my-children, obey Levi and-Judah, and-be-not-lifted-up-against-these-two-tribes, for-from-them shall-arise-unto-you the-salvation-of-God.
**5:2** For-the-LORD shall-raise-up from-Levi as-it-were a-High-Priest, and-from-Judah as-it-were a-King: [God-and-man] shall-he-be; he-shall-save-all-the-races-of-men.
**5:3** For-the-LORD shall-bless Levi, and-Judah; the-Levites shall-be-sanctified-in-the-LORD for-ever, and Judah's-people shall-be-glorified in-the-most-high.
**5:4** For-the-LORD has-chosen them-both; yea and-the-first-chosen shall-be-Levi, and-the-second-chosen shall-be-Judah.
**5:5** And-because-of-this I-command-you to-honour them, that-you-sin-not against-them, that-God-may-not-smite-you.
**5:6** And-I-will-tell-you the-rest-of-the-doings-of-my-life concerning-Joseph.

**6:1** Joseph was-a-good-man and-had-the-Spirit-of-God in-him; being-compassionate-and-pitiful, he-bore-no-malice-against-me, but-loved-me even-as-the-rest-of-his-brethren.
**6:2** Take-heed then, my-children, of-all-jealousy and-envy; and-walk-in-singleness-of-heart, that-God-may-give-you-also-grace, and-glory, and-blessing-upon-your-heads, even-as-ye-have-seen-in-Joseph.
**6:3** All-his-days he-reproached-us-not concerning-this-thing, but-loved-us-as-his-own-soul, and-beyond-his-own-sons-glorified-us; and-gave-us-riches, and-cattle, and-fruits.
**6:4** Do-you-also-then, my-children, love-each-one-his-brother, and-put-away-envy-from-your-hearts, loving-one-another in-deed-and-in-word-and-in-the-inclination-of-your-souls.

**7:1** And-after-he-had-slept, his-sons carried-him up-and-buried-him-in-Hebron with-his-fathers. And-the-days-of-Simeon were-a-hundred-and-twenty-years.

---
*End of Testament of Simeon*
